Source hierarchy and current behavior:

- [declaration_source.rs:179](/Users/jamie/development/exposed.kani-identity-verification/exposed/src/lib/outbound/declaration_source.rs:179) `decode_source` chooses the latest version, retains `parentInterestId`, and extracts funding occurrences.
- [declaration_source.rs:224](/Users/jamie/development/exposed.kani-identity-verification/exposed/src/lib/outbound/declaration_source.rs:224) `funding_entries` recursively passes each nested field collection separately. `Donors` collections use `Name` as donor name.
- [declaration_source.rs:250](/Users/jamie/development/exposed.kani-identity-verification/exposed/src/lib/outbound/declaration_source.rs:250) `parse_funding_entry` reads `DonorStatus` and `DonorCompanyIdentifier` only from the supplied field collection. It receives no parent metadata.
- [declaration_ingestion.rs:157](/Users/jamie/development/exposed.kani-identity-verification/exposed/src/lib/domain/models/declaration_ingestion.rs:157) `CapturedFundingEntry::new` retains supplied options without inheritance.
- [declaration_cleaning.rs:490](/Users/jamie/development/exposed.kani-identity-verification/exposed/src/lib/domain/models/declaration_cleaning.rs:490) `add_roles` attaches kind/company only to donor observations. Payer and ultimate payer observations receive neither. [input.rs:328](/Users/jamie/development/exposed.kani-identity-verification/exposed/src/lib/domain/models/declaration_resolution/input.rs:328) rejects non-donor observations carrying those fields.
- [attribution.rs:75](/Users/jamie/development/exposed.kani-identity-verification/exposed/src/lib/domain/models/declaration_resolution/attribution.rs:75) `parent_selection` selects the immediate parent’s unique same-member root payer when the flag is `Some(false)`. This selects an observation; it does not populate missing child metadata.
- `identity.rs` owns company parsing, kind conflicts, component company conflicts, ambiguous attachments, and identity outcomes.

Existing tests distinguish the contracts:

- [API tests:80](/Users/jamie/development/exposed.kani-identity-verification/exposed/src/lib/outbound/parliament_api/declarations/tests.rs:80) explicitly asserts nested entries retain missing kind/company despite those fields existing at the top level.
- Resolution tests cover parent selection/withholding (:436), absent/true flags and cycles (:547), different member (:612), multiple root payers (:632), competing company attachment (:307), person/company incompatibility (:351), company parsing (:378), and indirect conflicting-company components (:669).

For Kani scope: unchanged `identity.rs` plus `attribution.rs` covers resolution after source projection. To verify whether missing fields propagate from source parents, additionally exercise canonical `funding_entries`, `parse_funding_entry`, and cleaning `add_roles`/`from_captures`; otherwise document that boundary and retain source-level integration tests. Include canonical `is_root` and valid-input checks, especially the prohibition on payer donor metadata, to avoid proving behavior for impossible production inputs.
